user.title: PJM Sensor
user.description: Choose sensors and thresholds. Secure keeps the existing conservative policy; Intermediate permits conditional two-hour coverage; Reliable permits up to three clock hours but still obeys your elapsed-time cap (120 minutes by default). Experimental diagnostics do not control production curtailment.

data.cover_mode: Cover mode: secure, intermediate, or reliable

error.max_sensors_exceeded_without_api_key: Without your own subscription key, select at most three sensors.
error.unsupported_da_zone: Day-ahead prices require a supported transmission zone, such as COMED; PJM-RTO is not supported.
